title: Average value
task: Calculate the average value of a function on an interval as its integral divided by the length of the interval.

steps.text: Type frac to open a fraction template.
In the numerator, type int and fill in the bounds, the integrand and the differential.
Press the down arrow to move to the denominator and type the length of the interval.

lines.typed: frac, then int, 0, 2, f(x), dx over 2

exam_habit.text: The written setup shows the division, since a definite integral presented as the average value with no division by the length of the interval is the error readers record.

sources.anchor_quote: Move to Denominator Within Fraction | DOWN ARROW | DOWN ARROW
enter a lower bound, upper bound, integrand, and differential
the correct answer will suffice as evidence of division by 4
